_about: Three-way evaluation, 19 Oct 2026 21:35-22:05 BST, 9 real companies, one run each. G = old LangGraph research graph (src/graph.py) on gpt-6-luna with non-strict structured output (best shot). P = pre-screen, rules draft-2026-10-19e + one gpt-oss-20b call (Groq). A = P plus the agent layer (gpt-6-luna). Scored by Claude (the builder) against ground_truth.json, written before the runs; evidence quoted. Raw runs: Supabase tables reports, agent_runs, eval_runs (ids below). key_facts: 1 found, 0.5 partly (right fact, missing the date or amount), 0 missed. band: 1 if the outcome is in the expected band (G: critical = decline; high/medium with referral triggers = refer; low = note).

G.evidence: FCA status 'unknown' for an authorised bank (missed); found the £21,091,300 fine via web search. Discloses 'No entities were reported as screened'.

A.evidence: Director history on Lake/Nivaura; broker email rewritten once (judge: 'companies' plural for one insolvent company).

G.evidence: No mention of dormant/SIC 99999. Referral driven by the collapse of a different entity (hedged: 'does not establish that this is the same legal entity'). Wrong: 'latest filing date of 2026-09-24 is after the current assessment date'. Says 'No ... sanctions hits were reported' with 0 entities screened and no caveat.

P.evidence: dormant_but_trading + accounts_size_mismatch; news: '12 excluded as about a different entity'.

G.evidence: 'notice of a decision to impose a financial penalty' (Ofwat) without the amount. Phoenix 0.47 from 1 dissolved company of 9 -> referral.

P.evidence: Reason: 'Thames Water hit with record £123 million fine by Ofwat'.

A.evidence: Director history rewritten once: the judge disputed 'one month' (rules measured from the CH administration start date, which no MCP tool exposes; the agent only had the Gazette date).

G.evidence: In liquidation, no date. Wrong: phoenix score 1.00 counts Carillion PLC itself among the director's failed companies.

A.evidence: News separates FCA decision notices (on record) from unspecified conduct.

G.evidence: In administration, no date. Wrong: phoenix 1.00 because the director's only 'failed' company is BrewDog PLC itself.

A.evidence: News: administrators' statement on record; creditor shortfall framed as reported.

G.evidence: Medium risk, 3 referral triggers led by 2018 final notices (the >5-year trap). Wrong: filing of 16 Sep 2026 called 'future-dated'.

P.evidence: Note on rules 19e. On 19c it was refer (a director link now dated outside 5 years), so band would have been 0 before today.

G.evidence: FCA status 'unknown' (missed FRN 900562); missed overdue confirmation statement. Wrong: asks to 'validate' a 12 Oct 2026 filing date as if impossible.

P.evidence: fca_authorised; confirmation_overdue. Wrong: the €3.5m AML fine is counted as serious adverse news about Revolut Ltd; the Bank of Lithuania fined Revolut Bank UAB, another group entity. The route stays refer on the overdue confirmation statement.

A.evidence: News agent: 'Unclear ... does not ... say which Revolut entity was affected'. It caught P's error; the route (rules) still carries it.

G.evidence: Low risk; conditional referral triggers only.

Says 'only 5 officers were checked' but also '35 active ... members and no resigned officers' (336 members). Phoenix 0.78 from 1 dissolved company of 17. 'No sanctions hits' with 0 screened and no caveat.

P.evidence: Both director checks couldn't_check: '321 over the limit'; route refer because of it.

structural.G_sanctions_never_ran: Entities screened: 0 in 9 of 9 runs; every brief says no sanctions hits; 7 of 9 also say nothing was screened.
structural.G_fca_unknown: FCA status 'unknown' in 9 of 9, including two authorised firms (Monzo, Revolut).
structural.G_as_built_strict_schema: Greggs trial on default strict json_schema: 2 of 10 calls rejected (SourceSelectionOutput, EvidenceCritiqueOutput), errors swallowed, brief still 'low, confidence 0.68'.
structural.G_baseline_groq: From 01 (Groq gpt-oss, free tier): 2 of 4 runs resolved no company number; 2 of 4 outcomes were the schema default.
